name: Pendulum Squat
steps: Step onto the footplate with your back braced against the pad, shoulders tucked snugly beneath the yokes, and feet shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety catches, brace your core, and lower along the machine's arc by flexing your knees and hips smoothly.
Descend into a deep controlled squat while keeping your heels planted flat and your lower back pressed against the pad.
Drive powerfully through your midfoot to extend your knees and hips back to the top without snapping your knees straight.
tips: Place your feet lower on the platform for greater quad emphasis while keeping your heels flat throughout.
Control the bottom transition smoothly rather than bouncing off the mechanical stops.
